Item 8.01. Other Events.
On 31 August 2005, the company issued a press release containing information relating to the impact of Hurricane Katrina on the company’s hydrogen production. A copy of the press release is being furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K. The information contained in Exhibit 99.1 is being furnished; it is not deemed to be filed.
